slides.title: 5 things your seniors wish they knew before placements
Your seniors are your best job board
slides.body: They know which teams are hiring before the posting goes live. Ask them first.

slides.title: Start the conversation before you need a favour
slides.body: A 'how did you get into product?' message in 3rd year beats a 'pls refer' in 4th.

slides.title: Ask for 15 minutes, not a job
slides.body: People say yes to small asks. The referral often follows the conversation.

slides.title: Practise with someone who's been in that room
slides.body: A mock interview with an alum who cleared it is worth ten YouTube videos.

slides.title: Close the loop
slides.body: Got the offer? Tell the senior who helped. That's how the chain keeps going.

slides.title: Save this. Send it to your placement buddy.
slides.body: MyCampusForum connects you with seniors and alumni from your own college for referrals, mocks and advice.
